title: Kagamine Rin — The Arrogant Princess〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: Riliane
rows.Line:
Where could Allen be...?
Did something happen to him...?

rows.Speaker: Riliane
rows.Line: No, he already has Leonhart under his belt. A wench should pose no threat to him.

rows.Speaker: Riliane
rows.Line: Once that green-haired thief is out of the way, Kyle will have no choice but to come crawling back to me...

rows.Speaker: Riliane
rows.Line: (As much as I trust Allen, I am starting to wonder if I should not have entrusted this matter to someone else...)

rows.Speaker: Chief Handmaiden
rows.Line: Your Highness, the meeting is about to start.

rows.Speaker: Riliane
rows.Line: This is going to be about the war against Elphegort again, no? It will only be a waste of time since Allen will be completing his task soon...

rows.Speaker: Riliane
rows.Line: No, I must present myself as regally as Mother did when she was the queen...

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: I was such a fool then...

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: I truly believed that the war I waged would result in my beloved returning to me.

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: Anger and rage against “The Daughter of Evil” had reached its peak and finally boiled over.

rows.Speaker: Rebels
rows.Line:
“Hear our anger!!”
“End her reign of evil!!”

rows.Speaker: Allen
rows.Line: Is it to your liking, your Highness...?

rows.Speaker: Riliane
rows.Line:
A little sweet perhaps.
I believe brioche is better when the sweetness is on the milder side.

rows.Speaker: Riliane
rows.Line:
Please, hold my hand...
It just will not stop shaking...

rows.Speaker: Riliane
rows.Line: For some strange reason, you holding my hand puts me at ease.

rows.Speaker: Riliane
rows.Line:
I simply wished to be like Mother.
Regal and kindhearted.

rows.Speaker: Riliane
rows.Line: She never showed weakness in front of others either. She was always strong and firm. She commanded respect as a ruler should.

rows.Speaker: Riliane
rows.Line: But look at me... I command no such respect... Not only that, I am the cause of my own downfall...

rows.Speaker: Riliane
rows.Line:
You stayed until the very end.
You remained loyal all this time.

rows.Speaker: Riliane
rows.Line: Since the end appears to be nigh, I must thank you for that.

rows.Speaker: Allen
rows.Line: Your Highness, if you will allow, may I make a request of you...?

rows.Speaker: Riliane
rows.Line: You really are the spitting image of me, Allen...

rows.Speaker: Allen
rows.Line: This may give you enough time to slip out of the palace...

rows.Speaker: Allen
rows.Line: Riliane, you have to run out the back way.

rows.Speaker: Allen
rows.Line: I have your horse, Josephine, waiting out back. Take her and run as far away as you can from the rebels...

rows.Speaker: Riliane
rows.Line: What are you saying?! If I go and they find out, they will come after me...

rows.Speaker: Allen
rows.Line: It will be as if she never left at all.

rows.Speaker: Riliane
rows.Line:
No... No, please!
We may look alike, but aren't even related! They will see through this ruse!

rows.Speaker: Allen
rows.Line: Again, they won't. After all, we're twins. I seriously doubt they'll figure it out.

rows.Speaker: Allen
rows.Line:
Yes. I'm your brother.
I doubt you remember...

rows.Speaker: Riliane
rows.Line:
No, no, no...!
You know what's going to happen, right?!

rows.Speaker: Allen
rows.Line:
No, I definitely did.
I am “The Servant of Evil” to “The Daughter of Evil”.

rows.Speaker: Allen
rows.Line: But  I won't be able to do anything for you after this...

rows.Speaker: Allen
rows.Line: You have to go, Riliane, now.

rows.Speaker: Riliane
rows.Line:
Allen, please...
Don't go... Let me out!

rows.Speaker: Riliane
rows.Line:
*Sob*
I don't remember anything from back then...!

rows.Speaker: Allen's Voice
rows.Line:
Goodbye, Riliane...
Please, live on and don't look back.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Is that sapling the friend you were talking about...?

rows.Speaker: Nun
rows.Line: Yes. I'd like to take it back to the forest back home. Would you mind helping me, Rin?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Is it really okay for you to stay silent about me? You know why I'm repenting, right...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I let someone take the fall for me and...

rows.Speaker: Nun
rows.Line: You have nothing to worry about. I decided not to hold that against you...

rows.Speaker: Nun
rows.Line: I mean, Rin, wouldn't you feel lonely if a friend left your side?

rows.Speaker: Nun
rows.Line: That is why I'd like you to come with me.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (Being all alone is a painful thing.)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Allen...
I promise to keep living.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Allen...
Do you think we'll ever see each other again...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
If we do get that chance...
I want to talk and have fun with you as much as I can.
